record.title: Prepare one stopped RAW range diagnostic from the preserved stock controller
record.intent: Resolve the initial waveform and headroom ambiguity before proposing a new comparison protocol.
requirements: Preserve the sealed failed A1 and unchanged75-slot contract. User continuation authorizes a separate one-record diagnostic, not relaxation or reuse of prior comparison records.

Prepare a fresh explicitly pinned successor using reviewed owned capture/isolation/lease/ADB/epoch/restoration modules. Exact stock epoch and valid isolated lease must be revalidated at runtime. No reboot, root restart, native, protected-corpus or wiring change.

Use one nominal100MHz/raw-power0 UART attempt without retry, then one RUN-to-STOP RAW acquisition at100mVdiv,50ohm/DC/1x/zero/FULL,1usdiv/100k/4GSa. Preserve all raw bytes and equal preambles before interpreting waveform. Built-ins are supplementary, not a substitute or pre-acquisition range veto. Require finite samples, exact geometry and declared diagnostic headroom of strict +/-0.36V/Vpp0.72V. Any failure is retained and evaluated without automatic retry.

Restore the complete initial ordinary/export snapshot while framing healthy, including impedance and trigger run state. Preserve after/restored epoch checks, graceful capture/drop statistics, owned server absence before address removal. No controller runs during preparation.

Independently review exact source diff, runtime pins and fresh concrete control. Use focused offline controls for diagnostic schedule/range, malformed or incomplete RAW, stopped-state/export geometry, and restoration/owned transport order. Keep strict typed authored adapters and documented unchanged legacy boundaries.
acceptance: A single diagnostic controller and exact bindings are independently accepted or held with preserved negative evidence.
